honesty.artix7: PNR-open: yosys synth_xilinx and nextpnr-xilinx on the Nexys A7 part (xc7a100tcsg324-1), each candidate out of context in a wrapper that only registers its inputs and folds its outputs into a register; cells are yosys's for the candidate's own module, the frequency nextpnr's post-route estimate, not vendor signoff. The fabric map times every cell; the native map's DSP, block-RAM, LUT-RAM and SRL cells are not timed by nextpnr-xilinx, so its frequency is reported only where the design has none. A run nextpnr's default router (router2) cannot finish routing within its deadline is run once more with the older router (router1), the row naming its router and keeping router2's verdict.
honesty.derived: Throughput is the median routed fabric frequency divided by the candidate's steady cycles per result: an open-flow estimate of results per second, never a silicon measurement.
honesty.dram_derived: A K7 controller's megabytes a second per thousand LUTs is its traffic-gate throughput over the LUTs of its Artix-7 fabric map: what its area buys at DDR2-400, whatever clock it closes at.
honesty.function: SIM: an Icarus Verilog simulation of each candidate inside the shared harness; PASS only when the MISR signature of its first 1000 results equals the golden on both stimulus modes.
honesty.k7: K7 has no harness contract. Its functional gate is the traffic gate (SIM): every controller carries the same stream of 64-bit words, written then read back, to a behavioural model of the Nexys A7's DDR2 (MT47H64M16HR-25) at DDR2-400 through an ideal PHY; its bus is held to the JEDEC DDR2 rules and every word read back is checked. Spans and latencies are DRAM clocks; throughput counts the words written and read over the stream's span. On hardware, a controller's gate is a board memtest.
honesty.power: GDS-VCD: each candidate inside its functional harness, hardened whole on sky130A at its kernel's iso period (or, after a setup miss there, at the period its run needs), simulated at gate level over a window of whole operations once its pipeline is full; OpenSTA reads that window's activity on the routed netlist with its extracted parasitics, at every corner, with the upstream fix that lets it use every annotated activity. Energy per operation is power times the window's length over its operations. The candidate's is its own cells', the buffers the flow inserted inside it, and the clock tree's in the share of clock sinks that are its own; the whole block's is beside it, never subtracted.
honesty.sky130: GDS: OpenLane v1 (yosys, OpenROAD, Magic, Netgen, KLayout) on sky130A with the repo's overlay (its SHA3-256 in flows.sky130, one per kernel), each candidate out of context in its fold wrapper at a clock the bench sets; a control runs a candidate on OpenLane as released at the same commit, the overlay's contribution the difference. Attempts and controls alike run OpenLane's image at that commit with its OpenROAD (41a51eaf) rebuilt with one fix (scripts/openroad, the image in flows.sky130): repair_timing walks a net's global route into a buffered tree, and on a route that closes a cycle the released walk never ends and overflows the stack; the fixed walk takes a route without a cycle exactly as before and one with a cycle once over a spanning tree. A candidate closes at a period when its run is signoff-clean (every corner meets setup and hold; DRC, LVS, antenna and routing clean). Its own minimum is the shortest period it closed at; a kernel's iso period is the longest own minimum among its candidates. Areas are the candidate's own module as synthesis reports it and the whole wrapped design's post-route standard-cell area with physical-only cells left out; the die and core areas are set by the floorplan and are not compared. Every run starts in the first of flows.sky130_floorplans; one the global router refuses for congestion, or one that meets timing and fails signoff only on antenna pins no repair could fit, is run again in the next, its core utilization and placement density lowered together, and its row names the floorplan it ran in and each one left before it, with why. Every candidate runs the one comparative flow whose full config is flows.sky130_settings: every candidate is synthesized for delay, a run that misses setup at its typical corner completes and records the slack it missed by, synthesis check findings are recorded rather than stopping the flow, hold is repaired with a margin that covers every corner, and a pin still violating antenna where the jog router stops gets one more diode.
